Why we're here

From AI curiosity to an AI capability.

You don't need to become a technologist. The goal is to leave with ideas you can put to work immediately.

01

See AI in context

Connect Claude to trusted business information instead of relying only on what you paste into a chat.

02

Understand the connection

See how MCP lets an AI assistant discover and use capabilities across Salesforce, Google, and other systems.

03

Leave with a starting point

Identify one daily workflow you can improve with AI — and a practical next step to take after the workshop.

What you'll walk away with

A working assistant on your systems Claude connected to Google and Salesforce, running real queries on your data.
A workflow of your own One recurring task — meeting prep, inbox triage, weekly digest — handed off to Claude by the end of the session.
An executive dashboard A polished, self-contained BWOB impact dashboard you built by asking, not coding.
A vocabulary for the boardroom Enough MCP fluency to ask sharp questions of your IT teams and your AI vendors.
The executive experience: speak in business language. Let AI translate that into the right tools, data, and actions.
